task: Add deterministic CLI diagnosis and explicit repair for wrapper-root gitRoot layouts.
outcome: User runs `lattice config doctor` in a wrapper root and sees `gitRoot suggestion: clawcreek` plus `repairCommand: lattice config repair --set-git-root=clawcreek --confirm`; after running the repair command, `lattice story_resolve --storyId=B-3938 --format=json` reports `resolved: true`, `resolutionSource: configured-git-root`, and the signed workspace points at the child git repo.
facts: B-3938 exposed a wrapper-root layout where metadataRoot is not git-backed and the actual git repo is a child directory.
story_resolve/review_run_start already fail closed when metadataRoot is not git and no worktree/gitRoot binding exists.
Project config already has a gitRoot field and split-root resolver support for configured gitRoot.
lattice_config_doctor is the existing read-only config diagnostic surface and has the alias `lattice config doctor`.
field-regression-cli-smoke already has helper coverage for wrapper root projects with nested git repos.
constraints: Do not make runtime signed-workspace resolution silently guess child repositories.
Do not let Claude/Codex hosts become authoritative repair agents; hosts can only execute visible Lattice commands.
Do not optimize broadly or introduce arbitrary discovery depth; only fix the concrete wrapper-root correctness UX.
Repair must require explicit gitRoot and confirmation, validate the target, and avoid unrelated config writes.
Multiple child git repositories must remain fail-closed with a diagnostic ambiguity message.
